description.value: Pavilion Restaurant is a full-service sit-down restaurant in Prince Rupert offering a broad menu spanning local BC seafood (halibut, ling cod, BC mussels, ahi tuna), South Asian curries, burgers, steaks, and pasta. The kitchen emphasizes fresh, locally sourced ingredients and works with local farmers and producers as part of an explicit sustainability commitment. The restaurant also accommodates group dining, birthday celebrations, and conference meetups, making it a practical option for larger touring parties.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at pavilionrestaurant.ca is fully accessible and confirms the OSM address (346 Stiles Pl, Prince Rupert, BC V8J 3S5) and provides a phone number not present in OSM. The menu explicitly labels one dish as 'Vegan' and includes multiple other vegetarian dishes. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, takeout, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone +1 250-624-2727 sourced from website only.
No bike-specific amenities (parking, racks, washroom access) are mentioned on the website; these fields remain unverified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, full-service restaurant in Prince Rupert with a diverse menu including vegan options — a useful food stop for touring cyclists on the northern BC coast and Inside Passage route.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly labels 'Quinoa Bowl With Blackened Tofu Vegan $19.5'; additional vegetarian options include Hummus + Pita, Fresh Green Salad, Sweet Yam Fries, Spinach Dip, and Cauliflower Manchurian. No GF labelling observed
